population: Global YouTube videos that the platform classified as related to the NFL, not individual NFL fans or sports creators.

publication_gates.reason: Platform reported source metric scope and global period for the four published comparisons.
Source reports relative 2020–2025 annual view and upload growth; endpoint magnitude bounds only.
Intermediate years and per-month data not publicly reconstructed.
One reported within-year offseason share does not identify an annual recurring causal seasonal lift.
No creator compensation, production hours, licensing costs or newcomer sample.

interpretation_rules: More than 30% of 2025 NFL-related views in the offseason is a within-year share, NOT 30% growth and not all-year monthly distribution.
More than 250% view growth over five years and over 400% upload growth apply to different metric units and cannot be added or divided into creator profits.
Do not fill missing 2021–24 years with an exponential or linear interpolated time series.
Source-defined related-video classification and public-view history must be treated as first-party platform aggregates.
View events are not distinct fans, active unique people or measured audience earnings.
An NFL sports audience must not be confused with football/soccer video or general youth audience estimates.
